changes: Calendar refresh now updates changed events and removes deleted or cancelled Google instances. Refresh calendar is visible at the top, with last-updated and error details. Automatic refresh checks run at 07:00 and 19:00 Vienna time while the app is open, and catch up when reopened.
Choose Day, Week or Month, with separate all-day entries, hourly columns, previous/next navigation and Today. Work is one category, including Karin and Barbara.

Calendar imports cover the past and next year rather than expanding endless recurring series. Cloud saves send changed records in small transactions; Retry cloud backup keeps local changes safe, and calendar updates appear across devices.
Upgrades preserve pending local calendar edits and source removals across cloud retries, including when an older version did not store a merge baseline.
